title.narrative: EU Shared Action: Rule of Law Project - Phase 2 (SHARP 2)

description.narrative: The contract foresees to contribute to increasing public awareness on rule of law in Libya through the consolidation and expansion of a network of community-based consultative mechanisms across the country. It includes the organisation of inclusive community-based dialogues on justice, rule of law and positive citizenship as well as a scheme of small-scale projects in the same areas. It will also contribute to regional and national consensus-building to strengthen social cohesion.
